en.text: Thus all the work that Solomon did for the LORD’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated, even the silver, the gold, and all the vessels, and put them in the treasuries of God’s house.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门做完了耶和华殿的一切工，就把他父大卫分别为圣的金银和器皿都带来，放在 神殿的府库里。 （王上8·1—9）

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門做完了耶和華殿的一切工，就把他父大衛分別為聖的金銀和器皿都帶來，放在上帝殿的府庫裏。 （王上8‧1－9）

en.text: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，所罗门将以色列的长老、各支派的首领，并以色列的族长招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和华的约柜从大卫城—就是锡安—运上来。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，所羅門將以色列的長老、各支派的首領，並以色列的族長招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和華的約櫃從大衛城－就是錫安－運上來。

en.text: So all the men of Israel assembled themselves to the king at the feast, which was in the seventh month.

zhSimplified.text: 于是以色列众人在七月节前都聚集到王那里。

zhTraditional.text: 於是以色列眾人在七月節前都聚集到王那裏。

en.text: All the elders of Israel came. The Levites took up the ark.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列众长老来到，利未人便抬起约柜。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列眾長老來到，利未人便抬起約櫃。

en.text: They brought up the ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent. The Levitical priests brought these up.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司利未人将约柜运上来，又将会幕和会幕的一切圣器具都带上来。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司利未人將約櫃運上來，又將會幕和會幕的一切聖器具都帶上來。

en.text: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel who were assembled to him were before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门王和聚集到他那里的以色列全会众都在约柜前献牛羊为祭，多得不可胜数。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門王和聚集到他那裏的以色列全會眾都在約櫃前獻牛羊為祭，多得不可勝數。

en.text: The priests brought in the ark of the LORD’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubim.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司将耶和华的约柜抬进内殿，就是至圣所，放在两个基路伯的翅膀底下。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司將耶和華的約櫃抬進內殿，就是至聖所，放在兩個基路伯的翅膀底下。

en.text: For the cherubim spread out their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.

zhSimplified.text: 基路伯张着翅膀在约柜之上，遮掩约柜和抬柜的杠。

zhTraditional.text: 基路伯張着翅膀在約櫃之上，遮掩約櫃和抬櫃的槓。

en.text: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the ark in front of the inner sanctuary, but they were not seen outside; and it is there to this day.

zhSimplified.text: 这杠甚长，杠头在内殿前可以看见，在殿外却不能看见，直到如今还在那里。

zhTraditional.text: 這槓甚長，槓頭在內殿前可以看見，在殿外卻不能看見，直到如今還在那裏。

en.text: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

zhSimplified.text: 约柜里惟有两块石版，就是以色列人出埃及后，耶和华与他们立约的时候，摩西在何烈山所放的。除此以外，并无别物。

zhTraditional.text: 約櫃裏惟有兩塊石版，就是以色列人出埃及後，耶和華與他們立約的時候，摩西在何烈山所放的。除此以外，並無別物。

en.text: When the priests had come out of the holy place (for all the priests who were present had sanctified themselves, and didn’t keep their divisions;

zhSimplified.text: 当时，在那里所有的祭司都已自洁，并不分班供职。

zhTraditional.text: 當時，在那裏所有的祭司都已自潔，並不分班供職。

en.text: also the Levites who were the singers, all of them, even Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and their brothers, arrayed in fine linen, with cymbals and stringed instruments and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them one hundred twenty priests sounding with trumpets);

zhSimplified.text: 他们出圣所的时候，歌唱的利未人亚萨、希幔、耶杜顿，和他们的众子众弟兄都穿细麻布衣服，站在坛的东边，敲钹、鼓瑟、弹琴，同着他们有一百二十个祭司吹号。

zhTraditional.text: 他們出聖所的時候，歌唱的利未人亞薩、希幔、耶杜頓，和他們的眾子眾弟兄都穿細麻布衣服，站在壇的東邊，敲鈸、鼓瑟、彈琴，同着他們有一百二十個祭司吹號。

en.text: when the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of music, and praised the LORD, saying, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever!” then the house was filled with a cloud, even the LORD’s house,

zhSimplified.text: 吹号的、歌唱的都一齐发声，声合为一，赞美感谢耶和华。吹号、敲钹，用各种乐器，扬声赞美耶和华说： 耶和华本为善， 他的慈爱永远长存！

zhTraditional.text: 吹號的、歌唱的都一齊發聲，聲合為一，讚美感謝耶和華。吹號、敲鈸，用各種樂器，揚聲讚美耶和華說： 耶和華本為善， 他的慈愛永遠長存！

en.text: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for the LORD’s glory filled God’s house.

zhSimplified.text: 甚至祭司不能站立供职，因为耶和华的荣光充满了 神的殿。

zhTraditional.text: 甚至祭司不能站立供職，因為耶和華的榮光充滿了上帝的殿。
